paragraphs: Rav Mari, son of the daughter of Shmuel bar Shilat.

[Bava Batra 61b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.61b.10) mentions him. The supplied transcription has him reporting in his father’s name. Hyman reports that the words bar Shilat had already been removed from the Talmudic passage and are also absent in [Dikdukei Soferim](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/ASiAqDXazUEC?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA1-PA189).

notes.text: The supplied text says “his father,” while the consulted Bava Batra paragraph reads Abaye. The deletion of bar Shilat is Hyman’s reported textual correction; the present source wording remains unchanged.

[Heilprin’s entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2397&lang=en) gives Abaye as the authority and proposes that the additional words bar Shilat are a scribal error. Rabbinovicz preserves the words in parentheses in his printed-text column while recording their omission in other witnesses in note dalet.

Hyman’s printed article (vol. III, p. 907) and the consulted Bava Batra 61b both read “in Abaye’s name.” The supplied transcription reads “in his father’s name.” Dikdukei Soferim’s printed-text column gives bar Shilat in parentheses, and its manuscript column and note record the omission. Hyman retains bar Shilat in his heading.
